changelog: **Affiliate module, partner role and security (#3115):** new `Role.AFFILIATE` with its own shell at `/affiliate` (marketing vertical only, the same server-side 2FA gate as every role shell, its own menu for web and the native app — never the mentee portal) and a row in the 2FA coverage report. The partner contract is versioned per organisation (`src/lib/affiliateContract.ts`: a save bumps the version only on a real text change, compared locale by locale) and every partner API sits behind `affiliatePartnerGate()` (AFFILIATE only, own partner record, current contract accepted → otherwise 403/404/409). Payout details (IBAN, ISO 13616 check) are sealed per partner, masked to the last four characters, refused while impersonating or while an un-enrolled partner is held by the 2FA policy, audited, and announced with the new `payoutDetailsChanged` security notice. Payment, resync and contract writes leave `affiliate.*` AuditLog rows. SSO role sync never touches an AFFILIATE. The marketing demo tenant gets a demo partner.

en: Affiliate partners get their own sign-in area and are covered by your two-factor policy.
Partners must accept the current programme contract before they can use their area, and they are notified whenever their payout bank details change.
tr: Affiliate partnerleri kendi giriş alanına sahip ve iki adımlı doğrulama politikanız onları da kapsıyor.
Partnerler, alanlarını kullanmadan önce güncel program sözleşmesini kabul ediyor ve ödeme banka bilgileri her değiştiğinde bilgilendiriliyor.
de: Affiliate-Partner erhalten einen eigenen Anmeldebereich und sind von Ihrer Zwei-Faktor-Richtlinie erfasst.
Partner müssen den aktuellen Programmvertrag akzeptieren, bevor sie ihren Bereich nutzen, und werden bei jeder Änderung ihrer Bankverbindung für Auszahlungen benachrichtigt.
